messages.author: e7c1c94188a28a69
messages.subject: Joint disease modeling.
parts:
Dear INLA Family.
Kindly assist me in modeling two diseases jointly. where the Joint modeling is initiated by either a Multivariate conditional autorgressive(MCAR)-structured or a MVN distribution-unstructured.
I have been able to do this in WinBUGS. i.e.
HIV=B0+B1*AGE+B2*Education+...+S[1,region(i)], 1=HIV
HERPES=B0+B1*AGE+B2*Education+...+S[2,region(i)], 2=HERPES, S[j,region[i]] is the random effect

##in winBUGS S[j,region(i)]~mv.car(adj....omega..)initiates the joint modeling between HIV and HERPES etc.##

So in INLA, I have tried reading through the group to find address to similar problem but haven't been lucky. Please assist in doing the above in INLA.
Elphas
